data.title: China’s Xi visits Egypt as US sanctions threat looms

data.title: Premier League clubs chase last-minute transfer deals

data.title: New body to turn education research into policy
data.description: The problems with reforming education may lie less in a lack of research, funding or expertise than in a failure to get evidence into policy and the classroom, the Equitable Education Fund (EEF) says.

data.title: Dissevered body scattered along train tracks in Hat Yai
data.description: SONGKHLA - The dissevered body of a 62-year-old Myanmar man was found scattered along the railway track under the Lopburi Ramesuan twin bridges in Hat Yai, Songkhla, on Monday evening.

data.title: Five fluffy new arrivals join Khon Kaen Zoo’s flamingo flock
data.description: KHON KAEN - Khon Kaen Zoo is celebrating the successful hatching of five greater flamingo chicks, marking another step in its efforts to strengthen wildlife breeding and conservation programmes.

data.title: Women face hygiene woes in Nepal flood relief camp
data.description: NUWAKOT, Nepal - Scores of women queued at a school sheltering Nepal flood victims, jostling to lreceive personal-care supplies, as concerns over sanitation and menstrual hygiene mount days after the catastrophic disaster.

data.title: Ukraine’s defences, ‘hybrid’ threat from Moscow headline EU talks
data.description: WICKLOW, Ireland - EU defence ministers grappled on Tuesday with bolstering Ukraine’s air defences, as worries grow over Russia’s campaign to destabilise Kyiv’s European backers.

data.title: Tibet activists accuse China of downplaying floods
data.description: DHARAMSALA, India - Exiled Tibetans and advocacy groups have accused China of heavily underreporting the death toll from devastating flooding in border regions with Nepal, claims Beijing rejected as “malicious smearing and sensationalism”.

data.title: Brothers linked to Australia-bound ‘ice’ shipments
data.description: NAKHON SI THAMMARAT - Two Thai brothers were arrested on Tuesday for alleged involvement in a Rayong-based drug smuggling network that used tourist boats to ferry their illegal Australia-bound cargo.

data.title: National disaster insurance scheme approved
data.description: The cabinet on Tuesday approved in principle the establishment of a National Disaster Insurance System to provide coverage for floods, storms and earthquakes, expected to cover about 30 million households.

data.title: Audemars Piguet unveils its new boutique concept in bangkok
data.description: Swiss HauteHorlogeriemanufacturerAudemars Piguetiscontinuing the international rollout of itsglobal boutique conceptinthe heart ofBangkok,attheCentral Embassymall.An immersive environment with watches at the centre, the new space spans 264 square metres. Drawing inspiration from the landscapes surrounding Audemars Piguet’s home in LeBrassus, the contemporary interior design invites visitors to step into the Manufacture’s heritage and forward-looking approach to fine watchmaking. Unveiled on 15 June, the boutique will be complemented by an interactive pop-up installation from 11-25 August that offers the public an opportunity to discover the Royal Oak Offshore and its distinctive design codes.

data.title: The Science of Brain Recovery: Neurobiology, Clinical Evidence, and Integrated Treatment for Addiction and Mental Health
data.description: For decades, substance dependence and chronic mood disorders were widely misunderstood as personal shortcomings or failures of willpower. Modern neuroscience and clinical medicine have fundamentally shifted this paradigm: substance use disorders (SUD) and psychiatric conditions are complex neurobiological disorders involving structural and chemical dysregulations within the central nervous system.

data.title: 30-day visa-free stays to take effect on Sept 15
data.description: The new 30-day limit for visa-free stays in Thailand has been formally announced and will take effect on Sept 15 for visitors from 60 countries.

data.title: Drunken Indian tourist decked in Pattaya car park

data.title: Sihasak favours extending border fence with Malaysia
data.description: Foreign Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow wants to further extend the fence long the border with Malaysia to help curb smuggling of untaxed goods and drugs.

data.title: Japan to relax overtime regulation under workaholic PM
data.description: TOKYO — Japan will ease overtime regulation starting Tuesday in a move meant to help spur economic growth but criticised as a relapse into the country's ingrained workaholic culture.

data.title: Afghanistan war victims left 'without justice', UN says
data.description: KABUL - Most civilian victims of Afghanistan's 2001-2021 war have been left "without justice, reparation or even acknowledgement" of their suffering, the United Nations (UN) said Tuesday, with one man in Kabul telling Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) "the world has forgotten us".
